notes.finding: The predicate first requires center distance strictly below a circumscribed-radius threshold, then tests 2D polygon intersection.
notes.limit: A sampled geometry predicate under the library implementation, not swept-volume contact or measured impact. Radius equality is excluded by the first test.

notes.finding: A track token enters the seen set on its first detected overlap and is omitted at all later history samples.
notes.limit: Counts concern distinct first-seen collided tracks, not every recurrent contact episode. No track identity/annotation completeness is established.

notes.finding: Classification prioritizes stopped ego, stopped track, rear, front-bumper and then lateral contact.
notes.limit: Stopped ego and rear contact are still collisions even when absent from the at-fault subset.

notes.finding: At-fault selection includes front and stopped-track collisions, plus lateral collisions when the timestamp is absent from the supplied common/connected-route set.
notes.limit: This is an explicit heuristic; code states the classification is incomplete. Map associations are a separate dependency, not causal blame.

notes.finding: Per-group score is max(0, 1-count/(threshold+1)); total score is their product unless there are no at-fault collisions.
notes.limit: A nonzero score is not a no-contact assertion. With the default object threshold one, one object collision contributes one half.

notes.finding: The metric iterates history.data, stamps first detections with ego_state.time_point.time_us, and constructs aggregate results with time_series=None. all_collisions remains an in-memory member.
notes.limit: An aggregate score file alone does not establish event times, sample coverage or complete history. No continuous-time collision onset is determined.

notes.finding: TimePoint declares microseconds since epoch and converts to seconds by multiplication by 1e-6.
notes.limit: This declares software units and origin convention, not sensor synchronization or a physical calibration/error bound.

notes.finding: Nominal database interval is 0.05 seconds divided by subsample ratio. Iteration count is the length of available tokens; each iteration time is read from its database token.
notes.limit: Actual intervals, monotonicity and completeness must be checked from future records; nominal rate is not observed sampling proof.

notes.finding: Extraction forms start/end timestamps from anchor plus offset/duration in microseconds, then requests every reciprocal-subsample row.
notes.limit: Requested duration does not establish retained history duration.

notes.finding: The SQL query selects existing rows in an inclusive timestamp window, applies a row-number stride and orders by timestamp.
notes.limit: No regular-time-grid or full-duration assertion is made by this query; records near log boundaries or with gaps require explicit accounting.

notes.finding: The controller begins at zero, increments before testing end, and ends when index >= N-1.
notes.limit: Together with pre-increment history insertion and normal runner control, N>=2 yields history indices 0 through N-2. This is a source-level deduction, not a replayed simulator result.

notes.finding: Propagation appends the current state to history before advancing the controller; a missing next iteration sets the running flag false.
notes.limit: Selected normal path has no collision or mission-goal termination branch. Arbitrary callbacks/controllers and external process kills are outside this conclusion.

notes.finding: RunnerReport starts succeeded=True; its start/end times use perf_counter. Metrics callbacks occur after the loop.
notes.limit: Execution success is separate from driving success. These times are host execution timing, not scenario event timestamps; the normal end timestamp precedes end callbacks.

notes.finding: Synchronous exceptions produce a failed report or are re-raised when requested. The executor waits on metric/log callback futures and marks reported exceptions failed.
notes.limit: Missing reports, killed workers or unavailable future completion remain unknown until accounted for. This is not independent censoring evidence.

notes.finding: Metrics are built only when run_metric is enabled; a MetricCallback is attached only when a matching metric engine exists.
notes.limit: Runner success alone cannot establish that the collision metric was enabled or produced a result.

notes.finding: Metric computation exceptions are re-raised as RuntimeError.
notes.limit: No metric failure may be silently recoded as a zero collision count.

notes.finding: The selected controller passes the difference between next/current iteration timestamps to its motion model.
notes.limit: A future saved history must still bind ego timestamps to iteration timestamps and actual resolved classes.

notes.finding: The selected bicycle model stamps its next state with prior time plus sampling time.
notes.limit: Software propagation does not qualify physical dynamics or sensor timing.

notes.finding: TracksObservation replays scenario objects at the current iteration and advances that index to the next iteration.
notes.limit: Nonreactive logged agents are not measured counterfactual reactions to the simulated ego.

notes.finding: The log callback rejects empty history and otherwise submits/saves it.
notes.limit: Its inspected end callback does not compare saved sample count to a prespecified common horizon.

notes.finding: Competition prose specifies a one-second planner iteration budget, up-to-fifteen-second horizon and 10 Hz frequency.
notes.limit: The selected local runner itself has no matching one-second timeout branch. Remote server/watchdog enforcement is not qualified by this audit.

interpretation: Investigator source review; digests and AST checks do not prove semantic truth or native execution.
